home.destinationsSummary: A curated preview of the island's most loved heritage, highland, wildlife, and coastal destinations.

destinations.name: Sigiriya
destinations.shortDescription: Fifth-century rock fortress rising dramatically above royal water gardens and forest canopies.
destinations.detailedDescription: Rising nearly 200 metres above the central plains, Sigiriya unites ancient landscape engineering, vivid cliffside frescoes, and sweeping sunrise panoramas.
destinations.highlights: Sunrise Lion Rock climb | Pidurangala viewpoint | Ancient water gardens
destinations.imageAlt: Sigiriya Lion Rock towering over misty green jungle at dawn
destinations.topAttractions: Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress | Pidurangala Sunrise Rock | Royal Water & Boulder Gardens | Dambulla Cave Temple
destinations.thingsToDo: Climb Lion Rock at 7:00 AM before midday heat | Cycle shaded village tracks past lotus tanks | Join an afternoon elephant safari at Minneriya or Kaudulla | Enjoy a traditional clay-pot village lunch
destinations.travelInfo: Approx. 3.5 – 4 hours by private A/C vehicle from Colombo or Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB) via Kurunegala. Easily combined with Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, and Kandy.

photoGallery.caption: Sigiriya Lion Rock rising through morning mist
Nearby Cultural Triangle sacred heritage landscapes
Forest sanctuary stays surrounding the Cultural Triangle

destinations.name: Ella
destinations.shortDescription: Cloud-wrapped mountain town famed for the Nine Arch Bridge, scenic trains, and ridge hikes.
destinations.detailedDescription: Perched along the southern rim of the central highlands, Ella rewards slow mornings overlooking emerald ravines and panoramic tea valleys.
destinations.highlights: Nine Arch Bridge | Little Adam's Peak | Scenic highland rail
destinations.imageAlt: Iconic mountain train crossing Ella's Nine Arch Bridge
destinations.topAttractions: Nine Arch Bridge (Demodara) | Little Adam’s Peak | Ella Rock Viewpoint | Ravana Waterfall & Diyaluma Falls
destinations.thingsToDo: Ride the scenic hill-country train from Nanu Oya or Kandy | Walk the gentle Little Adam’s Peak trail at sunrise | Visit a working highland tea factory | Relax at hillside cafes overlooking Ella Gap
destinations.travelInfo: Approx. 5 – 5.5 hours from Colombo via Southern Expressway & Wellawaya, or pair a private chauffeur drop-off in Nanu Oya with the scenic 3-hour mountain train directly into Ella.

photoGallery.caption: Classic highland train crossing the Nine Arch Bridge
Misty emerald valley views from highland retreats
Sunrise ridgeline walks across the Uva highlands

destinations.name: Nuwara Eliya
destinations.shortDescription: Cool emerald tea slopes, cascading waterfalls, and timeless planters' bungalows.
destinations.detailedDescription: Surrounded by high-grown Ceylon tea estates at 1,800 metres, Nuwara Eliya offers private factory tastings and tranquil mountain gardens.
destinations.highlights: Single-estate tea tasting | Horton Plains plateau | Heritage bungalows
destinations.imageAlt: Misty green terraced tea slopes in Nuwara Eliya
destinations.topAttractions: Single-Origin Ceylon Tea Estates | Horton Plains & World’s End | Gregory Lake Promenade | Hakgala Botanical Garden
destinations.thingsToDo: Sample silver tips and high-grown teas with estate hosts | Take an early-morning trek to Baker’s Falls | Boat across cool Gregory Lake with family | Unwind by a hearth in a heritage planter bungalow
destinations.travelInfo: Approx. 4.5 hours from Colombo via Ginigathena or 2.5 hours uphill from Kandy along winding tea-draped roads. Bring a light jacket for cool 14–20°C evenings.

photoGallery.caption: Rolling emerald Ceylon tea slopes in Nuwara Eliya
Quiet highland verandas overlooking misty hills at dusk
Morning tea surrounded by highland cloud forest

destinations.name: Kandy
destinations.shortDescription: Sri Lanka's sacred hill capital encircling a tranquil lake beneath forested ridges.
destinations.detailedDescription: Home to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens, Kandy links the Cultural Triangle with tea country.
destinations.highlights: Temple of the Sacred Tooth | Kandy Lake twilight | Botanical Gardens
destinations.imageAlt: Kandy Lake and sacred heritage skyline framed by misty hills
destinations.topAttractions: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic (Sri Dalada Maligawa) | Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens | Kandy Lake Walk | Bahirawakanda Viewpoint
destinations.thingsToDo: Attend evening Thevava drumming offerings at the sacred temple | Stroll century-old palm avenues at Peradeniya | Explore local spice and handicraft markets | Watch traditional Kandyan cultural dance at twilight
destinations.travelInfo: Approx. 3 – 3.5 hours from Colombo or CMB Airport via the Central Expressway & Kadugannawa Pass, or via intercity train from Colombo Fort. Natural gateway between Cultural Triangle and Tea Country.

photoGallery.caption: Kandy Lake and sacred hill-capital heritage
Traditional Kandyan cultural drumming and Ves dance
Fragrant central-highland spices and Sri Lankan cuisine

destinations.name: Galle
destinations.shortDescription: Living UNESCO fortress of coral-stone ramparts, artisan boutiques, and ocean breezes.
destinations.detailedDescription: Inside seventeenth-century Dutch fortifications, restored colonial mansions house intimate boutique hotels, spice kitchens, and sunset bastions.
destinations.highlights: Sunset rampart walk | Galle Lighthouse | Artisan courtyards
destinations.imageAlt: Historic Galle Fort ramparts and white lighthouse along the coast
destinations.topAttractions: UNESCO Galle Dutch Fort Ramparts | Galle Lighthouse & Flag Rock | Pedlar Street Heritage Lanes | Handunugoda Tea & Southern Cinnamon Estates
destinations.thingsToDo: Walk the coral-stone fort bastions at sunset | Browse local artisan boutiques and spice courtyards | Cycle quiet southern paddy lanes | Pair a fort stay with nearby Unawatuna or Habaraduwa beaches
destinations.travelInfo: Just 2 hours from Colombo or 2.5 hours from CMB Airport via the Southern Expressway — making Galle one of Sri Lanka’s easiest luxury or family weekend escapes.

photoGallery.caption: Galle Fort lighthouse and coral-stone ocean bastions
Golden family-friendly southern beaches minutes away
Warm coastal hospitality and sunlit verandas

destinations.name: Mirissa
destinations.shortDescription: Palm-crowned headlands, crescent golden bays, and calm Indian Ocean waters.
destinations.detailedDescription: Mirissa pairs warm sandy coves and sunrise walks atop Coconut Tree Hill with seasonal offshore marine sightings and coastal cuisine.
destinations.highlights: Coconut Tree Hill | Southern coves | Seasonal marine sightings
destinations.imageAlt: Mirissa palm hill overlooking turquoise Indian Ocean bays
destinations.topAttractions: Coconut Tree Hill | Mirissa Crescent Bay | Secret Beach Cove | Weligama Beginner Surf Bay (15 mins away)
destinations.thingsToDo: Watch sunrise from Coconut Tree Hill | Swim calm seasonal waters from November to April | Take beginner surf lessons in nearby Weligama | Enjoy freshly grilled coastal seafood at dusk
destinations.travelInfo: Approx. 2.5 hours from Colombo via the Southern Expressway (Imaduwa or Kokmaduwa exit). Ideal pairing with Galle Fort and Yala National Park.

photoGallery.caption: Palm-crowned Coconut Tree Hill overlooking turquoise surf
Wide golden southern shorelines and calm sunset seas
Relaxed palm-shaded family walks beside the bay

destinations.name: Yala
destinations.shortDescription: Dry-zone coastal sanctuary renowned for Sri Lankan leopards, elephants, and birdlife.
destinations.detailedDescription: Bordering wild ocean dunes and granite outcrops, Yala delivers atmospheric dawn and dusk private safari drives.
destinations.highlights: Private dawn safari | Leopard & elephant habitat | Tented camps
destinations.imageAlt: Sri Lankan leopard on a granite boulder at golden hour in Yala
destinations.topAttractions: Yala National Park Block 1 & Block 5 | Sithulpawwa Rock Monastery | Coastal Sand Dunes & Lagoons | Bundala Bird Sanctuary nearby
destinations.thingsToDo: Join a 5:30 AM dawn 4x4 safari drive for cooler wildlife activity | Spot Sri Lankan leopards, elephants, peacocks, and sloth bears | Unwind at an eco-lodge or tented camp | Combine with Ella or Mirissa in 2–3 hours
destinations.travelInfo: Approx. 4.5 hours from Colombo via the Southern Expressway extension to Mattala/Tissamaharama, or 2.5 hours descending from Ella. Park Block 1 typically observes a seasonal maintenance closure in September.

photoGallery.caption: Sri Lankan leopard basking on warm granite rock at sunrise
Secluded wilderness lodges bordering dry-zone forest
Untamed southeast coastal lagoons and dunes

destinations.name: Trincomalee
destinations.shortDescription: Powder-soft Nilaveli sands, clear reef waters, and summer sunshine on the east coast.
destinations.detailedDescription: As the southwest enters monsoon months, Trincomalee shines with glassy turquoise coves, snorkelling waters, and historic harbour cliffs.
destinations.highlights: Nilaveli & Uppuveli beaches | Pigeon Island waters | Koneswaram headland
destinations.imageAlt: Calm turquoise bay and sunlit shoreline in Trincomalee
destinations.topAttractions: Nilaveli & Uppuveli Beaches | Pigeon Island Marine Sanctuary | Koneswaram Cliff Temple | Fort Frederick & Natural Harbour
destinations.thingsToDo: Swim glassy turquoise east-coast bays from May to September | Snorkel clear reef waters near Pigeon Island | Visit Koneswaram headland for Bay of Bengal vistas | Combine with Sigiriya or Anuradhapura on the drive inland
destinations.travelInfo: Approx. 5.5 hours from Colombo via Habarana, or just 2 hours from Sigiriya — making Trincomalee the ideal dry-season beach finale during southwest monsoon months (May – Sep).

photoGallery.caption: Calm crystalline turquoise waters along Trincomalee bay
Sun-drenched sandy east-coast family shoreline
Easy two-hour connection to Sigiriya and the Cultural Triangle

home.experiencesSummary: Go beyond sightseeing with immersive moments shaped by Sri Lanka's highland rails, tea craft, village kitchens, wild parks, surf coasts, and living traditions.

experiences.title: Scenic Train Journeys
experiences.description: Drift through emerald tea slopes, misty tunnels, and the Nine Arch Bridge on Sri Lanka's celebrated Kandy-to-Ella mountain railway.
experiences.imageAlt: Scenic highland train traversing stone viaduct surrounded by lush greenery
experiences.overview: Winding past emerald tea slopes, misty viaducts, cloud-forest tunnels, and hillside villages, Sri Lanka’s main highland rail line is one of the world’s most scenic journeys — equally cherished by Sri Lankan families and international visitors.
experiences.highlights: Iconic Kandy to Ella or Nanu Oya to Ella rail segments | Dramatic views across Nine Arch Bridge & tea valleys | Luggage transferred seamlessly by your private driver | Choice of reserved 1st, 2nd, or panoramic carriages (subject to rail release)
experiences.bestSeason: Year-round (Clearer mountain views Jan – May & Aug – Sep)
experiences.suitableFor: Families, Couples, Solo Travellers, Photography Enthusiasts, Groups
experiences.practicalInfo: Sri Lanka Railways opens reserved tickets approximately 30 days ahead. For comfort without long delays, we often recommend boarding the shorter, most scenic Nanu Oya to Ella stretch (approx. 3 hours) while your private vehicle carries your bags to meet you at Ella Station.

photoGallery.caption: Mountain train gliding over Ella’s Nine Arch Bridge
Terraced tea slopes visible along the hill-country rail
Misty highland valleys welcoming arrivals in Ella

experiences.title: Tea Estate Experiences
experiences.description: Walk hand-plucked highland trails with estate hosts and taste single-origin silver tips inside heritage Ceylon tea factories.
experiences.imageAlt: Misty terraced Ceylon tea plantation in Sri Lanka's central highlands
experiences.overview: Step inside Sri Lanka’s living Ceylon tea heritage with guided walks along misty terraced estates, heritage factory tours showing withering and rolling craft, and unhurried single-origin tastings.
experiences.highlights: Guided walk through emerald high-grown tea fields | Historic working tea factory tour | Single-estate tasting of Silver Tips, Pekoe & BOPF | Optional colonial tea bungalow high tea
experiences.bestSeason: Year-round (Crisp sunlit mornings Jan – Apr & Aug – Sep)
experiences.suitableFor: Families, Couples, Cultural Travellers, Culinary Enthusiasts
experiences.practicalInfo: Morning visits offer the freshest estate activity and clearest mountain light. Comfortable walking shoes and a light sweater are recommended in Nuwara Eliya and Hatton.

photoGallery.caption: Sun-dappled terraced Ceylon tea hills at dawn
Freshly brewed golden Ceylon tea service
Highland tea-country veranda overlooking misty ridges

experiences.title: Traditional Cooking
experiences.description: Visit morning village markets and prepare fragrant clay-pot curries, pol sambol, and hoppers over woodfire hearths.
experiences.imageAlt: Authentic Sri Lankan clay-pot curries, tropical spices, and woven serving platters
experiences.overview: Discover Sri Lanka’s vibrant culinary heritage from morning produce markets to fragrant clay-pot hearths. Learn to balance roasted curry spices, fresh coconut milk, garden herbs, and regional coastal or village recipes.
experiences.highlights: Guided local market & spice selection | Hands-on preparation of clay-pot curries & pol sambol | Crispy hoppers or string hoppers demonstration | Relaxed shared family-style meal
experiences.suitableFor: Families, Couples, Food Lovers, Small Groups
experiences.practicalInfo: Vegetarian, vegan, halal, and mild kid-friendly spice levels are happily accommodated with advance notice. Ideal as a relaxed afternoon activity in Sigiriya, Kandy, or Galle.

photoGallery.caption: Traditional clay-pot curries, whole spices, and woven platters
Warm Sri Lankan table hospitality and Ceylon tea

experiences.title: Wildlife Safaris
experiences.description: Track leopards, wild elephant herds, and migratory birdlife across Yala, Wilpattu, and Minneriya in private 4x4 safari jeeps.
experiences.imageAlt: Sri Lankan leopard resting on sun-warmed rock in Yala National Park
experiences.overview: Sri Lanka packs remarkable biodiversity into accessible dry-zone national parks. Travel in private open-air 4x4 safari jeeps with experienced local trackers to observe leopards, wild Asian elephants, sloth bears, and vibrant birdlife.
experiences.highlights: Private 4x4 safari jeep with dedicated local tracker | Dawn (5:30 AM) or afternoon game drives | Leopard sanctuaries in Yala & Wilpattu | Wild elephant herds in Udawalawe & Minneriya
experiences.duration: Half Day (4 Hours) or Full Day Safari
experiences.bestSeason: Feb – Jul & Nov – Jan (Yala/Wilpattu); Jun – Sep (Minneriya Gathering)
experiences.suitableFor: Families, Wildlife Photographers, Nature Lovers, Adventure Seekers
experiences.practicalInfo: Wear neutral earthy colours, bring binoculars and sun protection, and keep respectful quiet distances around animals. Park entry permits and jeep pickups from nearby hotels are coordinated in advance.

photoGallery.caption: Sri Lankan leopard perched on warm granite rock at sunrise
Southeast wilderness lagoons and coastal bird habitats

experiences.title: Surfing & Ocean Swells
experiences.description: Catch warm beginner-friendly southern waves in Weligama and Mirissa or iconic right-hand point breaks in Arugam Bay.
experiences.imageAlt: Clean golden morning surf swells curving into Arugam Bay
experiences.overview: Thanks to Sri Lanka’s twin monsoon seasons, warm tropical waves roll somewhere along the island’s coastline almost every month of the year — from gentle sandy beginner breaks in Weligama to classic right-hand point breaks in Arugam Bay.
experiences.highlights: Year-round warm-water surf seasons (South Nov–Apr, East May–Sep) | Certified beginner surf coaching & board rentals | Sunrise sessions in Weligama, Hiriketiya & Arugam Bay | Coastal beach cafes and lagoon kayaking nearby
experiences.bestSeason: Nov – Apr (South & West Coast) | May – Sep (Arugam Bay East Coast)
experiences.suitableFor: Beginners, Active Couples, Friends, Youth & Adventure Travellers
experiences.practicalInfo: Early morning sessions between 6:30 AM and 9:30 AM offer the cleanest glassy waves and gentler sun. Reef-safe sunscreen and rash guards are recommended.

photoGallery.caption: Golden sunrise swells rolling into Arugam Bay
Turquoise southern bays around Mirissa and Weligama

experiences.title: Cultural Performances
experiences.description: Witness rhythmic Kandyan drums, ceremonial Ves dance traditions, and twilight temple offerings rooted in centuries of island artistry.
experiences.imageAlt: Traditional Kandyan cultural dancer beside a ceremonial brass oil lamp at twilight
experiences.overview: Experience centuries of Sri Lankan performing heritage — from resonant Geta Bera drums and ceremonial Kandyan Ves dance to living temple rituals and coastal artisan workshops.
experiences.highlights: Traditional Kandyan drumming & Ves dance ensembles | Evening Thevava offerings at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth | Low-country mask & folk heritage along the south coast | Respectful cultural context from local guides
experiences.bestSeason: Year-round (Esala Perahera festival typically July/August in Kandy)
experiences.suitableFor: Families, Culture Seekers, Multi-Generational Groups, International Visitors
experiences.practicalInfo: Dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered when combining performances with visits to sacred temples. Front-row seating and private transfers can be arranged ahead of busy holiday evenings.

photoGallery.caption: Traditional Kandyan Ves dancer beside ceremonial brass oil lamp
Kandy’s historic lakeside temple precinct at twilight

experiences.title: Highland & Forest Hiking
experiences.description: Trek misty ridgelines across Ella Rock, Little Adam's Peak, Horton Plains, and the biodiverse Knuckles Conservation Forest.
experiences.imageAlt: Misty highland mountain ridges overlooking Sri Lankan cloud forests
experiences.location: Ella · Knuckles Range · Horton Plains · Pekoe Trail
experiences.overview: Lace up for misty cloud-forest ridgelines, waterfall trails, and scenic segments of Sri Lanka’s Pekoe Trail — with route options ranging from gentle 90-minute family walks to full-day guided mountain treks.
experiences.highlights: Gentle sunrise hike to Little Adam’s Peak | Panoramic Ella Rock & Horton Plains World’s End trails | Guided biodiverse Knuckles Conservation Forest walks | Curated Pekoe Trail tea-country day stages
experiences.duration: 2 Hours to Full Day Guided Trek
experiences.bestSeason: Jan – May & Aug – Sep for clearest ridge panoramas
experiences.suitableFor: Active Travellers, Adventure Groups, Families (on gentle routes), Nature Photographers
experiences.practicalInfo: Start hikes early before highland clouds roll in around late morning. Good grip walking shoes, drinking water, and light rain layers are advised; experienced local trekking guides handle trail pacing and safety.

photoGallery.caption: Hikers crossing sunlit highland ridges above misty waterfalls
Cloud-draped emerald hills surrounding mountain lodges

experiences.title: Ayurveda & Wellness
experiences.description: Restore balance with botanical oil therapies, herbal steam rituals, and tranquil yoga pavilions set amidst tropical gardens.
experiences.imageAlt: Serene Sri Lankan Ayurveda wellness pavilion surrounded by tropical gardens
experiences.overview: Rooted in over two millennia of Sri Lankan botanical wisdom, authentic Ayurveda sanctuaries pair doctor consultations, warm herbal oil therapies, wholesome cuisine, and quiet tropical gardens for deep restoration.
experiences.highlights: Restorative herbal oil massages & steam rituals | Tranquil garden yoga & guided breathwork | Option for single spa afternoons or multi-day residential retreats | Calm coastal or jungle sanctuary environments
experiences.bestSeason: Year-round (Monsoon months offer especially peaceful retreat rates)
experiences.suitableFor: Couples, Solo Travellers, Seniors, Wellness & Slow-Travel Guests
experiences.practicalInfo: Choose between a relaxing half-day Ayurveda spa session during a normal holiday or a dedicated doctor-guided residential programme. Tell us your wellness goals so we match the right environment.

photoGallery.caption: Peaceful botanical Ayurveda pavilion amidst lush greenery
Serene open-air garden architecture for restorative stays

features.body: Well-maintained air-conditioned sedans, family vans, and coaches with courteous, road-experienced local chauffeurs.

features.body: Balanced multi-night pacing that leaves breathing room for morning tea, scenic train rides, and spontaneous local discoveries.

travelTips.title: Twin Monsoon Seasons
travelTips.body: The South, West, and Hill Country are typically driest from November to April, while Trincomalee and Arugam Bay shine from May to September.

travelTips.title: Comfortable Road Pacing
travelTips.body: Winding highland roads reward unhurried travel days. Spending 2–3 nights per region keeps family and couple journeys relaxed.

travelTips.title: Cultural & Wildlife Respect
travelTips.body: Dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered at sacred temples, and maintain respectful wildlife viewing distances inside national parks.

travelTips.title: Visas & Official Entry Rules
travelTips.body: Entry and Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) guidelines may change. Always verify latest rules on official Sri Lankan immigration portals.

faqs.question: Can every sample package be customised for domestic, inbound, or outbound travel?
faqs.answer: Yes. All featured packages serve as starting inspirations — duration, pickup points, hotel tier, and activities can be adjusted around your party and budget.

faqs.question: Are prices available in LKR as well as international currencies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Demo itineraries are shown in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR) by default, and merchants can configure LKR, USD, EUR, or GBP per package directly in Fivora.

faqs.question: Do you arrange airport pickups as well as Colombo, Kandy, and Galle departures?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private air-conditioned vehicles and chauffeur-guides can pick up directly from Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB), Colombo residences, or regional hubs.

faqs.question: Can you plan budget-friendly family getaways as well as luxury villa holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Accommodation and transport can be matched across comfortable value stays, boutique heritage hotels, eco-lodges, and private luxury villas.

faqs.question: How quickly can I send a WhatsApp inquiry?
